authorised_scope: one bounded, read-only, graded, de-duplicated recheck of the heuristic history hits; NOT a security-engineering campaign; NOT a history repair. The two known raw-value blobs keep their previous adjudication and the history-rewrite decision is NOT reopened.
claim_limits: the rule set is HEURISTIC: the absence of a hit is not the absence of a credential of a shape no rule describes
classification is by provenance, structure and non-reversible value features; a deliberately disguised secret could be misclassified
the sharp raw-token check bounds ONE shape only (a whole blob that is a bare 64-hex token) and says nothing about credentials embedded in other content
coverage is complete over reachable blobs and reported separately for unreachable ones; no claim is made about objects deleted before this run

coverage.note: unreachable objects are NOT part of the published history; they are local leftovers and are reported separately rather than counted as covered
